milestones.title: Measure and decide the discriminator
acceptance_criteria: Observe rig cumulative CPU-time deltas for a 46-row scratch harness, W1, and W2 with stable PID identity and 120-second endpoints; sandboxed external-path or socket observations are uninformative.
Observe /bin/bash tools/launchd/test_mission_stall.sh exit 0 with named 04:45-shape, W1, and W2 arms only if one measured threshold separates them; base is 16/16 green.
If measured deltas overlap, observe a policy decision returned to Mark and no watchdog implementation.

milestones.title: Implement approved cumulative CPU-time arm
acceptance_criteria: After Mark approves a measured threshold, observe bash -n tools/launchd/mission-control.sh exit 0.
Observe /bin/bash tools/launchd/test_mission_stall.sh exit 0 with the 04:45-shape live, W1 and W2 stalled, and named mutation victims red under one-line arm mutations.
Observe controller-run env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$PATH make test-launchd-drivers exit 0 outside the sandbox; a sandbox run touching sockets or external paths is uninformative.
